simple.meaning: תֶּלֶם (telem) is a Hebrew word meaning “a bank or terrace.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תֶּלֶם (H8525) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 31:38, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תֶּלֶם (H8525) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תֶּלֶם (H8525) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תֶּלֶם (telem) / H8525 is traced through Job 31:38, Job 39:10, Psalms 65:11, Hosea 10:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H8525. telem תֶּ֫לֶם noun masculine Job 31:38 furrow ; — absolute ׳ת 39:10 (other conjectures Du Perles Anal. 53 ); plural construct שָׂדָ֑י תַּלְמֵי Hosea 10:4 ; 12:12 ; suffix תְּלָמֶיהָ Job 31:38 ; Psa 65:11 . — On ploughing in Palestine see Hogg Ency. Bib. AGRICULTURE Vogelst Landwirthsch. 25 ff. , on depth of furrow (not more than 8-10 centimeters) Id ib.36 Anderlind ZPV ix. 25, 29 ; also Benz Archaeology under the word — תִּלָּם see תֵּל above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to accumulate ;
